t: Core Principles of Universal Software Generation Engines
title: Core Principles of Universal Software Generation Engines
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Four principles govern universal software generation engines. Principle 1: intelligence is prediction plus action under uncertainty: the system must model what happens next before it chooses. Principle 2: every autonomous step needs a verification step: generation without checking is not engineering. Principle 3: learning without forgetting requires guarded updates: new skills are proven against old benchmarks before they ship. Principle 4: capability must scale with oversight: the more the system can do, the stronger the monitoring and approval gates become. The piece records show where each principle is enforced in hardware and software.
